items.title: Bloom (biro portraits)
items.description: A six-figure ink study of a wildflower — every petal built from thousands of fine pen strokes on cotton paper.

items.title: Sea-Serpent
items.description: Layered washes of teal and copper that suggest a creature moving under water.

items.title: Bright Side
items.description: Four small colour studies on postcard paper — all about sun hitting a wall.

items.title: Gesture
items.description: A series of timed charcoal and ink studies capturing posture and breath.

items.title: Found
items.description: Assembled from torn maps and ticket stubs — memory you can hold.

items.title: Form
items.description: A small suspended bronze relief — line, weight and space in three dimensions.
